record.source_closeout_reference: Authored during the mission in the Claude Code session executing the sponsor-approved long-running-mission gap plan; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Draft the candidate V3-OP-003 long-running remote-interrupt profile and its decision pack with pre-written PASS, CONDITIONAL PASS, and NO PROMOTION YET criteria assessed at NO PROMOTION YET; add the same_commit convention to the mission-record design; update the V3-ANCHOR-004 row.

envelope.reference: Sponsor agreement with the five-gap analysis and instruction to address the gaps in sequence starting with the next three or four bounded missions
envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no live transport, messaging, or unattended execution approval
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push after approval
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond the candidate profile, decision pack, design-doc convention, registry row, and README bullet
any wording implies the candidate profile is approved or usable
decision criteria are written to fit evidence already held rather than evidence required
verification reports an unresolved advisory finding

verification.summary: Advisory lint initially returned ADVISORY_WARN V3-A002 because the decision pack's status line lacked the non-enforcing phrase; the wording was corrected and all checks then passed. NL pilot, knowledge lint, and diff checks passed; mission-record lint run after this record was authored.

notes: Docs-only change assembling existing canon (AMC v0.2, V3-OP-001 structure, mutable-state and provenance policies) into a candidate profile rather than inventing new machinery.
Decision criteria were written before any ladder evidence exists, fixing the goalposts; current assessment is honestly NO PROMOTION YET.
The no-response safe-hold rule is the only genuinely new mechanism and is specified as evidence discipline, not enforcement.
Scope stayed inside the named docs.
No approval, promotion, transport, or unattended-operation scope was added.

friction_notes: The decision pack forward-references DURATION_LADDER_PLAN.md, INTERRUPT_TRANSPORT_TRIAL_PLAN.md, and MISSION_HEALTH_VOCABULARY.md, which are created by the companion missions in this same change cycle; if those missions were abandoned the references would dangle.
The V3-A002 advisory warning was a useful true positive: a decision pack is exactly the artifact where missing non-enforcing language would be most dangerous.
false_positive_notes: The V3-A002 finding is classified as an accepted true positive, not a false positive.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the final advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Writing PASS/CONDITIONAL PASS/NO PROMOTION YET criteria before gathering evidence prevents goalpost drift and makes the eventual sponsor decision auditable.
CONDITIONAL PASS conditions need expiry semantics (revert to candidate if unmet) or conditions accumulate indefinitely.
The same_commit convention removes the hash-stamping follow-up commit; this record is its first use.
